Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the genealogical data presented in the Wikipedia infobox. In the final step, the Planner incorrectly identified "Concepción S enz de Tejada" as the maternal grandmother. The Wikipedia text explicitly states that Felipe is the "maternal-line grandson of King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sof a," and the infobox lists his mother as Infanta Elena. Since Infanta Elena is the daughter of King Juan Carlos I and Queen Sof a, Queen Sof a is the correct maternal grandmother. The Planner failed to correctly align the "Mother" field (Infanta Elena) with the corresponding grandparent pair in the infobox, instead erroneously selecting the paternal grandmother (Concepción S enz de Tejada) or misreading the "paternal-line grandson" line as the maternal one. This represents a failure in logical synthesis and data interpretation, contradicting the clear evidence provided in the same source.
